project: Workshop registrations: workshops, attendees, registrations; three feature modules plus a framework-free src/domain.
canonicalSource: NestJS documentation (docs.nestjs.com): Overview > Controllers, Providers, Modules, Exception filters, Guards; Fundamentals > Custom providers (non-class-based provider tokens, useClass). Layer model from presets/nestjs.yaml (controller -> service -> repository -> domain).
styleDefinition: Feature modules co-locate a controller (presentation), a service (application), DTOs (application) and a repository implementation (infrastructure); *.module.ts files wire them (presentation by the preset).

Layer order (preset): presentation -> application -> infrastructure -> domain. A service may call infrastructure; infrastructure must not call services or controllers; nothing in the domain depends outward.

This project binds repositories through injection tokens (Custom providers, useClass) to interfaces declared in src/domain, so services depend on ports, not on repository classes. Injecting a concrete repository into a service breaks that declared design (and DIP).
Controllers exchange DTOs with services; they do not hand domain entities to the transport layer.
The domain depends on no persistence or web framework (typeorm, express, prisma, sequelize per the preset; @nestjs/* is not forbidden by this preset).
No dependency cycles (the docs treat circular dependencies and forwardRef as something to avoid).

notApplicable.reason: no-layer-skip applies to style layered only (template applicability)

outOfScope: Coupling metrics (FF-C*), SOLID proxies (FF-SO*), naming and convention rules (FF-CV*) and the neuronal functions (FF-N*) are not compared: they are threshold proxies or conventions (FR-V6 makes them advisory), and they say nothing about whether a planted architectural violation is caught. The runner lists their rows separately as unscored.
